title: 第十八章 南荒北蛮面圣第十九章 屠城
content_zh:
现在的图娜青巴已经不知道要怎么处理接下来的事情，韩紫枫再次提议：“皇帝啊，咱们就算不难为这个公主，也要出一碗堕胎药吧？西凉穷的连碗正常药效的药都没有，咱身为大国，不能计较，咱出一碗便是。他们西凉穷的连个清白的公主都没有，咱身为大国，不能计较，随便给安排个男人，也就是啦。满朝文武家的男丁这么多，谁稍微委屈下，混个异族驸马当当，不行就去相馆找，大凛这么多人，总能扒拉出一个不嫌弃的吧？好歹人家嫁妆多。”
一群人分分钟笑场，这个妹子的思维真的够清奇，哈哈哈，这个真没毛病啊！皇帝对此也很开心，这话没问题，所以他说：“嗯，这个合理，朕准啦。”
图娜青巴可不干啦：“你们不能谋害我的孩儿，他可是西凉皇族。”
紫枫淡定的怼一句：“亲，这里是大凛皇族的说，咱真不稀罕西凉皇族的种。关键，丫的是真没大凛血脉，要他们何用？”满朝文武，齐齐点头，就算有什么异议，现在也不适合说啊！
紫枫还淡定的出馊主意：“皇帝啊，人家都出孕妇来篡权夺位，你说要不咱也发几个人过去，哦对，大皇子哪边不是已经有到位的大凛入西凉的皇子吗？要不叫那个哥们广撒网，帮他们家皇帝分担下。弄出一个属咱大凛的皇帝，也学学人家，不动一兵一卒，叫他们西凉皇族，改成新的大凛家族，想想都不错啊！”
皇帝眼睛晶晶亮，这个可以有啊！紫枫再次问：“皇帝啊，还要想到一个问题，要是西凉的皇帝不要脸，碰瓷咋弄？就说这妞肚子里的，就是咱大凛皇族的种，就说他们已经堕胎了，那真是百口莫辩，最简单的处理办法，既然来了干碗药再走，没了作案工具，怎么都清净了，难道他们有脸来说，他们是叫孕妇过来，谋朝篡位的？那不是找打架吗？好歹是当皇帝的，不能连b脸都不要了吧？”
图娜青巴这次是真急啦：“你们不能，你们不能这么做，她是我的孩子，你们不能谋杀我的孩子。”
紫枫淡定的说：“亲，这是大凛皇宫，你当真有人惯着你？简单的来说，你带着个肚子进皇宫，就是你不对，现在你想保他们，是完全不可能的事情好吧。皇帝啊，直接给那边的皇上些清楚，问他是不是要打架？并且叫这个使节，把死孩子直接带回去。要怕说不清，那就当众，当着百姓，给这个公主开膛破肚，当众取娃，反正人家都要打架啦，惯着他们干嘛？”
“她想要孩子也没问题，直接把两个崽子拿出来，不减脐带，再把肚子给她封上。看西凉有没有人娶这个，完全就是窑姐的破鞋。发动你们的脑洞，不能怂这个妞，酷刑，咱大国也是专业的。”
几个男人真的有点瑟瑟发抖，这个孩子的脑洞，是真的有些小恶心啦，不过，咋就那么解气呢，很想说，干的漂亮怎么破？这就太尴尬啦。
就这样，眼看事情有点控制不下去的使节，也开始玩混的，真的一开口，就是错：“哼，叫北空明娶我家公主，是他的福气，我们公主又没打算他能成为新的大凛皇帝，你们担心什么？”
紫枫别有深意的：“哦~，皇帝啊，真相啦。人家西凉皇帝在你家皇子这里，开盲盒呢，她家公主就打算买一送二，万一划拉上，就算中奖，没划拉上，也确保衣食无忧。你打了人家的崽子，人家害得有开战的理由。你才，周围其他的国家，会不会一起来，要求咱帮忙养娃？”
北空明诧异的问：“他们不至于这么无耻吧？”
紫枫淡定的回答：“无耻需要理由吗？一将成名万骨枯，现在是开攻城略地啊，无耻点怎么拉，能赢就行，脸就不要啦。”她这边话音才落，就听到一个跑进来的太监报告。
太监有点紧张的说：“报，八百里加急，南荒柳峰世；北蛮耶律世，大约明日，一同进城面圣。”
紫枫一摊手说：“你瞧，皇帝啊，咱家也不差一碗堕胎药，明儿他们不说也就算了，如果两国逼逼赖赖，那么咱就活体取婴，然后，就问他们两国有要的没就完事啦。”
皇帝想想说：“老二明儿你去接两国使臣，老大，你让户部，礼部在明日大早，去将军府娶亲，你们在明日早上，给老子吧婚礼处理明白，老子要三国使节，看着我家老三，风光的娶将军府的女儿。怎么风光怎么来，怎么嚣张怎么来。”
紫枫无语啊，不过，就这样吧。紫枫看着皇上，开始疯狂的打眼色，皇帝有点疑惑，但北空明算是明白啦，他很明显的看向某个外人，皇帝直接叫太监，把图娜青巴给带了下去，包括那个使节，都被监管起来。
紫枫此时问白莲花系统：“喂喂喂，你有任意门贩卖吗？”
霖华仙尊也忍不住咆哮啦：“不可能有那种东西的好吧？你要干嘛？”

紫枫淡定回答：“偷塔啊！他们三家的皇帝恶心我，屠城是来不及了，那我就把三个皇帝的脑袋拎过来，当十里红妆呗。”
霖华仙尊翻翻白眼说：“说好的白莲花呢？”
紫枫淡定的怼：“血莲不是莲呗，呗感染了不行吗？”
霖华仙尊直接被说笑了，果然，这个孩子不打算好好玩，才是那些人糟心的时候，他说：“大瞬移术。”
紫枫想想问：“提问：这个世界的皇帝这里，你能给弄个气运金龙什么的不？吞噬国家气运的那种。”
霖华仙尊淡定的回答：“你买个龙珠，自己培养呗，提示，需要这边皇族的血浸泡。”
紫枫：“老大，着急用的说。”
霖华仙尊回答：“一碗血，把珠子丢里面，一会儿就好。一条龙完全变成正常龙，就再换一颗珠子。”
紫枫淡定的问：“那么，怎么抽国运？”

Now Tuna Qingba no longer knew how to deal with the next matter. Han Zifeng suggested again: "Emperor, even if it is not difficult for this princess, we still have to provide a bowl of abortion pills, right? Xiliang is so poor that we don't even have a bowl of medicine with normal efficacy. As a big country, we can't care about it. I just give out a bowl. They are so poor in Xiliang." There is no such thing as an innocent princess. As a big country, we can’t care about finding a man at will. There are so many men from the civil and military families of the Manchu Dynasty. If you want to be a foreign consort, you can go to the photo studio to find one. With so many people, you can always find someone who doesn’t dislike it, right? "
A group of people were laughing every minute. This girl's thinking is really clear. Hahaha, there's nothing wrong with this! The emperor was also very happy about this, and there was no problem with this, so he said: "Well, this is reasonable, I am sure."
Tuna Qingba didn't want to do it: "You can't murder my child, he is from the Xiliang royal family."
Zifeng calmly retorted: "Dear, this is the Dalin royal family. We really don't care about the Xiliang royal family. The key point is that there is really no Dalin bloodline. What use are they?" All civil and military officials in the court nodded. Even if they have any objections, it is not the right time to talk now!
Zifeng calmly came up with the bad idea: "Emperor, people are sending pregnant women to usurp power. What do you think we should also send a few people there? Oh, right, isn't there already a prince who has entered Xiliang? How about the eldest prince? Ask that buddy to cast a wider net and help their emperor to share the burden. It’s a good idea to create an emperor who belongs to us, Dalin, and follow the example of others, without using any troops, and call them the Xiliang Royal Family, the new Dalin Family!”
The emperor's eyes are sparkling, you can have this! Zifeng asked again: "Emperor, there is another question that comes to mind. If the emperor of Xiliang is shameless, what should he do if he touches porcelain? Just say that what is in this girl's belly is the seed of our Dalin royal family, and say that they have had an abortion. That is really unreasonable and the simplest solution. The answer is, since we have no tools to commit the crime and are clean, do they have the nerve to say that they asked pregnant women to come here to usurp the throne? Isn’t that because they are the emperor, so they can’t even give up their face?”
Tuna Qingba was really anxious this time: "You can't, you can't do this, she is my child, you can't murder my child."
Zifeng said calmly: "Dear, this is the Dalin Palace, are you really being pampered by someone? To put it simply, you are wrong when you enter the palace with a pregnant belly. It is completely impossible for you to protect them now, okay. Emperor, just give it to the emperor over there If you want to know more clearly, ask him if he wants to fight? And ask the envoy to take the dead child back directly. If you are afraid of not being able to tell, then disembowel the princess in front of the people and take the baby in public. They are going to fight anyway, why do you want to spoil them? "
"It's okay if she wants to have a child. She just takes out the two babies without cutting off the umbilical cord, and then seals her belly. Let's see if anyone in Xiliang marries this. She's just like the old lady. Use your imagination and don't coward this girl. Our big country is also professional in torture."
A few men were really trembling. This child's mind was really a little disgusting. However, why did he just relieve his anger like that? I wanted to say, how can I break up if I did such a good job? This is so embarrassing.
Just like that, seeing that things were a bit out of control, the envoy also started to play around. When he really spoke, he was wrong: "Huh, asking Beikong Ming to marry my princess is his blessing. Our princess has no intention of him becoming the new Dalin Emperor. What are you worried about?"
Zifeng had a deep meaning: "Oh~, Emperor, here's the truth. The Emperor of Xiliang is opening a blind box at your prince's place, and her princess plans to buy one and get two free. If she draws the line, she will win the prize. If she doesn't, she won't win.Make sure you have enough food and clothing. If you beat someone's bastard, they will have a reason to start a war. You, will other countries around us come together and ask us to help raise children? "
Beikong Ming asked in surprise: "They are not so shameless, are they? "
Zifeng replied calmly: "Do you need a reason to be shameless? Once you become famous, your bones will wither. Now it's time to attack the city and seize territory. No matter how shameless you are, as long as you can win, you don't need to lose face. "As soon as she finished speaking, she heard a report from a eunuch who ran in.
The eunuch said a little nervously: "Report, eight hundred miles away, Liu Fengshi in the Southern Wilderness and Yelu Shi in the Northern Barbarian, about tomorrow, we will go to the city together to meet the Holy Spirit. "
Zifeng spread her hands and said: "Look, Emperor, our family is not short of a bowl of abortion pills. It's okay if they don't tell us tomorrow. If the two countries are forced to refuse, then we will take the babies from living bodies. Then, we will ask them if they want anything. That's it." "
The emperor thought about it and said: "Second brother, you go to pick up the envoys from the two countries tomorrow. Boss, you ask the Ministry of Household Affairs and the Ministry of Rites to go to the General's Mansion to get married early tomorrow morning. You can handle the wedding for me tomorrow morning. I want the envoys from the Three Kingdoms to see my youngest marry the daughter of the General's Mansion in a glorious manner." How come you are famous, how come you are arrogant. "
Zifeng was speechless, but so be it. Zifeng looked at the emperor and started to wink wildly. The emperor was a little confused, but Beikong Ming finally understood. He was obviously looking at an outsider. The emperor directly called the eunuch and took Tuna Qingba down. Everyone, including the envoy, was under supervision.
Zifeng asked the White Lotus system at this time: "Hey, hey, do you have any sales? "
Immortal Linhua couldn't help but roar: "There can't be such a thing, right? What do you want to do? "
Zifeng replied calmly: "Steal the tower! The emperors of the three families are disgusted with me, and it is too late to massacre the city, so I will take the heads of the three emperors and use them as Shili Hongzhuang. "
Immortal Linhua rolled his eyes and said, "Where's the promised white lotus? "
Zifeng calmly retorted: "The blood lotus is not a lotus, can it be infected? "
Immortal Linhua was directly laughed at. Sure enough, this child didn't intend to have fun, which was when those people were upset. He said: "The great teleportation technique. "
Zifeng wanted to ask: "Question: Can you get a lucky golden dragon or something for the emperor of this world? The kind that swallows up a country's luck. "
Immortal Linhua replied calmly: "Buy a dragon ball and cultivate it yourself. Note that it needs to be soaked in the blood of the royal family here. "
Zifeng: "Boss, just say it if you are in a hurry. "
Immortal Linhua replied: "Put the beads in a bowl of blood and it will be fine in a while. When a dragon completely transforms into a normal dragon, change another bead. "
Zifeng asked calmly: "So, how to win the national fortune? "
